chunks: And if you call them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you, while they do not see.
ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers fail to understand guidance even when it is clearly presented to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf highlights the spiritual blindness of those who reject Imam Ali (AS) and the Ahl al-Bayt, illustrating that mere physical presence before divine signs does not guarantee understanding. It underscores the concept of 'baṣīrah' (inner insight), where the heart remains sealed despite the eyes being open, a theme often linked to the fate of the disbelievers in the time of the Prophet and the Imams. This serves as a reminder that guidance requires not just hearing, but the spiritual capacity to perceive and accept the truth.
